verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is GPU accelerator hardware and a DGX server system, not an API service that issues credentials to agents. Scoped or least-privilege agent API credentials are a category error for this kind of product. The evidence mentions only generic BMC/Redfish/IPMI management interfaces and says nothing about credential scoping, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
